headline: Waymo says Singapore will be its next international robotaxi city
summary: Waymo plans to launch a robotaxi service in Singapore by 2028. Vehicles will arrive in the coming months for mapping and autonomous testing with safety drivers. The Alphabet-owned company continues its international expansion efforts.

headline: The AI Superintelligence Slowdown
summary: The rapid pace of AI development is shifting towards caution. After concerns about rogue AI, leading companies suggest a slowdown. Tech leaders are now publicly advocating for more responsible AI growth.

headline: Claude Code relaunches Projects to manage multiple AI agents in the cloud
summary: Claude Code's revamped Projects feature allows users to run multiple AI agents together. Agents within a project share memory, goals, and a library of files. A central 'coordinator' directs parallel tasks within project 'threads'.

headline: Save $30 or more on a refurbished Apple TV 4K
summary: Despite rising hardware prices, you can save on an Apple TV 4K. Refurbished models offer reduced costs, with the 64GB version selling for $169. Buying refurbished directly from Apple can offset new retail prices.

headline: Magic’s Most-Wanted Marvel Deck Is Discounted – Here’s Why You Should Consider This One Instead
summary: The MTG Marvel Doom Prevails Commander deck is currently discounted on Amazon. However, the Avengers Assemble deck offers superior gameplay value. Consider the Avengers Assemble deck for a better investment.

headline: Resident Evil Ending Explained
summary: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil film has been released. This article explains the movie's ending and its implications for the franchise's future. It also clarifies if there are any post-credits scenes.

headline: Save Up to 90% Off PC Games During Ubisoft's 40th Anniversary Sale, Plus Get One Game Totally Free
summary: Ubisoft is celebrating its 40th anniversary with a massive PC game sale. Players can save up to 90% on titles, with some starting at just two bucks. The sale also offers one PC game completely free.

headline: Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4, Episode 9 Recap and Review - It's Time for La'An Vs. La'An
summary: Episode 9 of Star Trek: Strange New Worlds Season 4 has aired. The review suggests the season is winding down towards its conclusion. The episode prominently features a conflict involving 'La'An Vs. La'An'.

headline: Remains found after wildfire identified as mother-of-three missing since 2019
summary: Remains found after a wildfire have been identified as Joanne Sheen, missing since 2019. The mother-of-three's body was discovered in London nearly seven years after her disappearance. A 56-year-old man has been arrested in connection with the case.

headline: Charles 'sounded giddily elated' after Diana died, Earl Spencer claims
summary: Earl Spencer claims Charles was 'giddily elated' following Princess Diana's death. These allegations are made in a new book by Diana's brother. Buckingham Palace has strongly refuted and pushed back against the claims.

headline: War may be coming. Are we psychologically ready?
summary: Military and government officials warn of an increasing risk of conflict. The article questions the public's psychological preparedness for war. It highlights potential gaps in mental readiness for future conflicts.

headline: US fans with Ed Sheeran tickets left 'torn' over Macklemore controversy
summary: US fans holding Ed Sheeran tickets are conflicted about attending upcoming gigs. Their dilemma stems from a controversy involving artist Macklemore. Many ticket holders are 'torn' on whether to go to the concert.
